base_url.correction: No single /v2 base URL. Local CLIP v2 uses https://<bridge-ip>/clip/v2/resource; remote access uses https://api.meethue.com/route/clip/v2/resource.

auth_type.correction: Local access uses a Hue application key in the hue-application-key header; remote access additionally uses OAuth2 bearer authorization. X-Api-Key is not the documented header.

free_tier_limits.correction: The official remote-API quota is 50,000 calls per day, not 1,000 requests per day.

rate_limits.correction: Philips Hue publishes a remote-API limit of 50,000 calls per day; exceeding it may cause throttling or access revocation.

example.correction: A local v2 request is: curl -k "https://<bridge-ip>/clip/v2/resource/light" -H "hue-application-key: YOUR_APPLICATION_KEY". The submitted URL, plural /lights path, X-Api-Key header, and V1-shaped response are inconsistent with CLIP v2.

notes: The API and documentation remain operational, but the entry conflates local and remote access. Its base URL, authentication, quota, curl example, and response format are wrong. Official terms currently publish a 50,000-call/day remote quota. No official pricing or CORS statement was located. The six duplicated weather use cases are unrelated to Hue.
